messages:
maria: Aventis sent their RFI responses back and flagged three exceptions: customer HSM for private installs, FedRAMP status for Dedicated, and how caching affects billing. Need a bundle for AE review by EOD Friday.
devin: Copying their asks: 1) Can customers bring their own HSMs into Private? 2) Is any Redwood offering FedRAMP-authorized? 3) Explain how prefix/KV caching changes token billing and samples of cost impact.
clare: I'll produce the capability CSV and attach an HSM diagram. Use this wording for HSM Q: "Private/on-prem can be configured to use customer HSM appliances and customer-managed cloud KMS. Hosted multitenant does not host customer HSM hardware."
ben: Quick facts for draft: FedRAMP - not authorized as of 2026-03-20; we offer partner-assisted or Dedicated roadmap options for regulated customers. Billing - Hosted = per-token; Dedicated = reserved commit + overage per-token; caching typically cuts billed tokens ~25-40% depending on workload.
security: Uploading vendor validation list: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, Thales Luna, Utimaco. I'll mark which are validated for Private.
clare: CSV snippet (will attach file): 
capability,hosted,dedicated,private,notes
SSO,yes,yes,yes,SAML/OIDC
Customer HSM,no,partial,yes,Hosted=no hardware HSM; Dedicated=cloud KMS; Private=on-prem HSM
KV caching,yes,yes,yes,Configurable prefix/KV caching; reduces billed tokens on hits
Streaming,yes,yes,yes,Streaming + chunked token responses

maria: Ben please draft placeholder pricing numbers for the worked example (we'll flag as estimates). Include baseline commit for 4x A100 and an overage rate per 1k tokens.
ben: Draft placeholders uploaded to Drive and marked internal. Example: 4xA100 commit = $27,000/mo; Dedicated overage = $0.58/1k tokens; Hosted gen = $0.03/1k tokens; example cache hit = 35%.
maria: Good. Ops-bot - set reminder for AE to review final bundle and list required attachments.
ops-bot: Reminder created: Aventis RFI bundle due 2026-03-26 17:00 PT. Required: capability_matrix.csv, security_questionnaire.pdf, hsm_diagram.png, pricing_estimate.xlsx. Notifying @maria.
clare: I'll assemble the bundle and draft the reply text: short factual answers + offer a 60-min architecture review with infra/SRE to validate HSM plan.
maria: Target upload Thu 16:30 PT so AE has time to sign off. Thanks team.
